name: Colossus
introduce:
KX-101HA 巨像
由卡玛达公司制造的重型机兵，第二世代技术集大成者。
虽为近期推出的新型机兵，但KX-101HA巨像却极为少见地没有以新奇设计为卖点，而是大量集成了成熟可靠的现有技术——厚实的复合装甲、充足的武器挂载，配以简易护盾发生器、局部战场数据链等等……这些经过实战检验的技术在配套开发的铁雨叠变器的整合下平稳地协同运作，将巨像的基础性能推向了极致，甚至在部分参数上大幅领先部分第三世代机兵。

20544.name: Iron Rain Mod
20544.SpecificEffects: Increases DMG dealt by <color=#F74848>15%</color> when attacking with tactical weapon. For each <color=#F74848>1</color> tactical ammo consumed, additionally increases DMG dealt by <color=#F74848>4%</color>, up to <color=#F74848>5</color> stacks, lasting for <color=#F74848>2</color> turns.

30448.name: Sturdy Shield Mod
30448.SpecificEffects: When attacked, if not possessing a shield layer, any undestroyed part having <color=#F74848>70%</color> or less HP gain a shield layer equal to <color=#F74848>15%</color> of that part max HP. When gaining shield layer, grants <buf ID=7100306>[DMG UP III]</buf> and <buf ID=7100106>[Hit Rate UP III]</buf> to self and <color=#F74848>1</color> random ally within <color=#F74848>2-tile diamond</color> area around self, lasting for <color=#F74848>2</color> turns.
